run_accuracy_test: run an accuracy test for a model against a dataset baseline using ModelLaunchSettings and AccuracyTestParams
write_accuracy_github_summary: write accuracy test results to a GitHub step summary markdown table with pass/fail status and scores
test_run_simple_eval: test the _run_simple_eval function that launches an sglang server and evaluates a model on a dataset
test_run_nemo_skills_eval: test the _run_nemo_skills_eval function that evaluates models using NeMo Skills for VLM benchmarks like mmmu-pro
create_accuracy_test_params: create an AccuracyTestParams dataclass with dataset, baseline accuracy, and optional inference parameters
